name: LLMTF
description: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) requires reliable and scalable evaluation tools. However, the research community faces significant fragmentation, outdated frameworks designed for foundational models, and closed proprietary benchmarks. These problems are particularly noticeable in the Russian-language segment, which suffers from a lack of high-quality datasets and open tools. To address these challenges, we introduce LLMTF1, a novel open framework and benchmark for evaluating LLMs.
